The app builds successfully (0 errors). Here's what was created:

### Project Structure
```
ShipmentTracker/
├── ShipmentTracker/            (Server — SSR + API)
│   ├── Data/
│   │   ├── Shipment.cs         ← EF Core entity
│   │   ├── SeedData.cs         ← Roles + 5 sample shipments
│   │   └── ApplicationDbContext.cs
│   ├── Components/
│   │   ├── Pages/Home.razor    ← Landing page
│   │   └── Layout/NavMenu.razor ← Role-aware nav
│   └── Program.cs              ← API endpoints + auth config
│
└── ShipmentTracker.Client/     (WASM — runs in browser)
    ├── Models/Shipment.cs      ← Shared DTO + ShipmentStatus enum
    └── Pages/
        ├── Dispatcher.razor    ← Full CRUD dashboard (Dispatcher role)
        ├── Track.razor         ← Public tracking with progress bar
        └── MyShipments.razor   ← Customer's shipment cards
```

### Key Design Decisions
| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load + snappy after | **InteractiveAuto** — SSR on first visit, WebAssembly thereafter |
| Worldwide latency | WASM runs locally in the browser — no server round-trips for UI |
| Interactive controls everywhere | All pages use `@rendermode InteractiveAuto` via Client project |
| Individual accounts | ASP.NET Identity with Dispatcher/Customer roles |
| Track page | Anonymous access — no login needed to look up a tracking number |

Run with `dotnet run --project ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker` — roles and seed data are created automatically on startup.
